faq.title: AI Music Generation FAQ
faq.description: About free test mode, real models, and credits.

items.question: What is Free Test Audio?
items.answer: It is a local test mode that creates playable test audio so you can verify auth, credits, task records, player, and download behavior.

items.question: Is Free Test Audio real AI music?
items.answer: No. It is for technical flow validation and does not represent final music quality. Use Stable Audio 3.0 for real music generation.

items.question: Why does Stable Audio 3.0 say insufficient credits?
items.answer: Stable Audio 3.0 consumes Stability platform credits. Those are separate from your site credits in the admin area.

items.question: How should I write prompts?
items.answer: Include genre, mood, BPM, instruments, use case, and sonic texture, such as “warm lo-fi, 90bpm, soft drums, night city atmosphere”.

items.question: What are site credits for?
items.answer: Site credits control how many generations a user can run on your website. External model generation still depends on that provider account balance.

items.question: Can I connect other music models later?
items.answer: Yes. The provider switch is already in place, so you can add Hugging Face, Replicate, Fal, or self-hosted models later.
